contrast.text: The calm workspace for growing teams
Make your next good idea feel inevitable.
Orbit gives product teams one focused place to plan, ship, and learn, with enough context to move forward and less noise
A lighter way to run serious work.
One shared place for the small rituals that move a product forward. Useful by default and flexible when it matters.
Turn a noisy backlog into one next move.
Give every bet an owner, a reason, and a visible path to done. Your team sees what matters before the next check-in.
See the work without chasing updates.
Small, legible project signals make the right conversation obvious.
Keep decisions close to the evidence.
Link research, feedback, and product context where choices are made.
More clarity, fewer meetings, happier makers.
“The team finally has enough context to make a decision without another meeting. Orbit feels like the quietest person in

Yes. The Starter plan is free, and team plans include a 14-day trial. This static demo does not create an account or sen

Orbit keeps priorities, evidence, and decisions connected. Teams can keep the delivery tools that already work for them.

Useful frameworks and team rituals, with no product spam.
